description: Land Acquisition - Goviyapana, Habaraduwa D/S Division, Galle District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1975/43 of 13.07.2016 by Kotapola D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations under Section 5 for acquiring specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. The content also includes an amendment notice correcting land names in a previous gazette. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it focuses exclusively on land and property-related administrative matters.
